title: Replace the X-axis way covers and wipers on a Haas vertical mill

machine_family.note: The official description says 'their Haas VMC'; the narration names VF-1 through VF-5 for the retrofit.

machine_model.note: Only the retrofit applies to named models (VF-1 to VF-5); the demonstration machine is not named.

subsystem.note: Named in the title and narration.

questions.question: What torque or check shows the rail fasteners are tight enough?
What coolant concentration is correct? The video does not give a number.
Cues 20-21 read 'remove the small Phillips screw with a flathead screwdriver the retaining strip towards the opposite end'. Is the flathead screwdriver used on the screw or on the retaining strip?
The captions say the largest leaf is 'away from the table' while the bead is applied. Is the largest leaf lifted off the table, or is the bead on the face farthest from it?

The narration says VF-1 through VF-5 changed in August 2013, while an on-screen caption elsewhere in the video gives a retrofit window of August 2013 to February 2016. Which machines need the retrofit?
